trigger.what: Rate Card Engine ingested the Meridian GRI: 5.9% on ground, 7.1% on residential surcharges, effective Oct 1.
Realized CPO moved from $8.72 to $9.34 in the weekly read — 62¢ of which is the GRI and 12¢ was already drifting.
Node Optimizer found 31% of Zone 7–8 orders shipping from the East node while the West held cover, and pinned the card.

policy.label: Postage
policy.note: zone × weight tier, after the GRI

constraints.label: Carrier volume minimums
constraints.detail: Meridian Express holds a 55% minimum share with a tiered discount that resets below it. Allocation can move within the band, not through it.

constraints.label: Rate card commitments
constraints.detail: Both national carriers are inside multi-year agreements to July. The GRI is contractual, so absorbing it is the only option — the question is what we stop paying elsewhere.

constraints.label: Marketplace SLAs
constraints.detail: Amazon and Walmart transit promises are platform terms. No routing rule may put them at risk to save postage.

constraints.label: Packaging safety spec
constraints.detail: Glass and enamel keep the current void-fill spec regardless of dim-weight savings. The damage ceiling is a floor on box choice, not a variable.
